summary: An authenticated Lumen Layouts SVG floor-planning workspace where users create durable plans, add and edit fixtures on a pan/zoom canvas, undo and redo edits, switch saved plans, export summaries, and print reports.

journeys.title: A signed-in user creates a floor plan, adds a fixture, edits it, saves it, and sees it after reload

steps.expect: the Lumen Layouts sign-in panel is visible with email and password controls

steps.action: create or sign in to an account
steps.expect: the workspace route opens and the user's plan list panel is visible
the canvas header displays Main Showroom Layout and the empty SVG workspace is visible

steps.action: drag a ceiling light fixture from the library onto the canvas
steps.expect: a selected ceiling light fixture appears on the SVG canvas and the inspector shows its details

steps.action: edit the selected fixture in the inspector
steps.expect: the selected fixture moves to the edited coordinates and the inspector displays rotation 45 and brightness 70
Main Showroom Layout is still selected and the edited ceiling light is visible on the canvas
the inspector displays position X 320, position Y 210, rotation 45, and brightness 70

acceptance: a named plan created in the browser remains visible after a full page reload
a fixture added to the SVG canvas remains visible after a full page reload
edited fixture position, rotation, and brightness remain visible after a full page reload

journeys.title: A user navigates and edits the canvas with pointer and keyboard-accessible alternatives

steps.expect: the saved plan canvas and toolbar controls are visible

steps.action: zoom the canvas in with the toolbar
steps.expect: the zoom readout increases and the SVG canvas content appears larger

steps.action: pan the canvas with keyboard controls
steps.expect: the pan readout changes and the visible canvas origin shifts

steps.action: focus the selected fixture and move it using keyboard nudges
steps.expect: the fixture moves by a keyboard nudge amount and the inspector coordinates update

steps.action: rotate the selected fixture with an accessible keyboard shortcut
steps.expect: the fixture rotates and the inspector rotation value changes

acceptance: toolbar zoom changes the visible SVG scale
keyboard panning changes the visible canvas offset
keyboard fixture movement updates the same inspector fields as pointer editing

journeys.title: A user undoes and redoes fixture edits

steps.expect: the saved plan and selected fixture are available
the inspector displays brightness 35 and the fixture visual brightness changes
the inspector restores the previous brightness value and the redo control becomes enabled
the inspector displays brightness 35 again and the undo control remains enabled

acceptance: undo visibly restores the previous fixture value
redo visibly reapplies the undone fixture value
undo and redo controls communicate disabled and enabled states

journeys.title: A user creates a second plan and switches between saved plans

steps.expect: the plan switcher shows Main Showroom Layout
the plan switcher includes Mezzanine Lighting Plan and the canvas shows an empty plan

steps.action: switch back to the first plan
steps.expect: Main Showroom Layout is selected and its ceiling light fixture is visible
Mezzanine Lighting Plan is selected and its canvas is empty

acceptance: the plan switcher lists more than one saved plan
switching plans changes the visible canvas contents
fixtures from one plan do not appear on another plan

journeys.title: A user views the separate fixture library route

steps.expect: the Lumen fixture library page is visible
fixture cards for ceiling light, wall sconce, pendant, and floor lamp are visible

steps.action: select a fixture type for details
steps.expect: the wall sconce details panel displays its default brightness and placement guidance

acceptance: the library is reachable at /library
fixture type cards are readable without opening a plan
selecting a fixture type shows a visible details panel

journeys.title: A user exports and prints a plan summary from the reports route

steps.expect: the plan summary report page is visible with a plan selector

steps.action: select Main Showroom Layout for reporting
steps.expect: the report preview lists Main Showroom Layout and its ceiling light fixture
a downloadable plan summary file is produced and the screen shows Export ready
a print-ready summary view opens with the plan name and fixture table visible

acceptance: the reports route previews the selected plan summary
export produces an observable downloadable result
print opens a print-ready view containing the selected plan name and fixture table

journeys.title: A user opens settings and signs out to confirm private workspace access

steps.expect: the settings page displays the signed-in account email and a sign-out control
the sign-in panel is visible

steps.action: attempt to open the workspace while signed out
steps.expect: the sign-in panel is shown instead of any saved plan canvas

acceptance: settings is reachable at /settings for signed-in users
signing out hides saved plan data
a signed-out visitor cannot view the workspace canvas

routes.name: Home and Auth
routes.purpose: Show Lumen Layouts branding and authentication controls, then route signed-in users to the workspace.

routes.name: Workspace
routes.purpose: Create, switch, save, pan, zoom, and edit SVG floor plans.

routes.name: Library
routes.purpose: Browse available fixture types and their placement guidance.

routes.name: Reports
routes.purpose: Preview, export, and print plan summaries.

routes.name: Settings
routes.purpose: Show account information and sign-out controls.

entities.name: plan
relationships: a plan belongs to one signed-in user

entities.name: fixture
relationships: a fixture belongs to one plan
a fixture belongs to one signed-in user through its plan

auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: a signed-out visitor sees the sign-in panel instead of protected routes
a signed-in user only sees plans they created
a signed-in user only sees fixtures belonging to their own plans
signing out hides workspace, reports, library, and settings content until authentication succeeds again

operations.description: authenticate a user with the platform auth SDK and load that user's plans
sign out with the platform auth SDK and clear protected workspace display
persist a new user-owned plan via db.entity('plan').create

responsibilities.behavior: initialize a new plan with default zoom 100, pan 0, pan 0, empty selection, and current timestamps

operations.description: persist pan and zoom viewport changes for the selected plan via db.entity('plan').update
create a fixture on the selected plan when the user drags or keyboard-adds it from the library

responsibilities.behavior: convert a chosen fixture type and drop coordinates into a fixture with a readable label, default rotation 0, default brightness 100, and next sort order

operations.description: persist fixture inspector and canvas edits via db.entity('fixture').update
restore the previous fixture editing state from the workspace undo stack and persist the restored values

responsibilities.behavior: apply the previous fixture state from the undo stack to the selected fixture and move that change to the redo stack

operations.description: reapply the next fixture editing state from the workspace redo stack and persist the values

responsibilities.behavior: apply the next fixture state from the redo stack to the selected fixture and move that change back to the undo stack

operations.description: produce a downloadable plan summary file for the selected plan and its fixtures

responsibilities.behavior: format the selected plan name, fixture count, and fixture table into a downloadable summary file

operations.description: produce a print-ready plan summary view for the selected plan and its fixtures

responsibilities.behavior: format the selected plan name, fixture count, and fixture table into a print-ready view

integrations.name: backend SDK auth
integrations.purpose: Authenticate users using the scaffolded auth object.

integrations.name: backend SDK database
integrations.purpose: Persist user-owned plans and fixtures using db.entity('plan') and db.entity('fixture').

acceptance.statement: a signed-in user can create a named plan and read the same plan after a full page reload
a fixture added to a plan is visible on the SVG canvas and remains visible after a full page reload
editing position, rotation, and brightness updates the visible fixture and the inspector values
keyboard-accessible canvas controls can pan the canvas and move or rotate a selected fixture
undo restores a previous fixture value and redo reapplies the edited value
switching between two saved plans changes the canvas contents to the selected plan only
exporting a report produces a downloadable plan summary containing the selected plan name and fixture table
printing a report opens a print-ready summary containing the selected plan name and fixture table
a signed-out visitor cannot view saved workspace content

deferred.reason: the request requires user-owned durable plans, not simultaneous shared editing
the request asks for a fixture library but does not require user-uploaded assets
the scaffold allows client-generated export and print output without adding external providers
the request requires position editing and summaries, not certified CAD measurement tooling
